alley.name: The Alley Behind the Mistletoe Lounge

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Christmas Eve. The kind of cold that gets into your boots and files a change of address.

lines.speaker: granny
lines.text: Are you the detective? Down here? Oh my. My Jimmy is missing.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: I weighed my options. Take the case. Or take the case. I took the case.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: My tinsel goggles. Sophisticated forensic instruments. Also festive.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: The alley smelled like jazz and wet carrots.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: A puddle. A top hat. A scarf. Could mean anything.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: Scorch marks, shaped exactly like hooves. Probably nothing.

lines.speaker: granny
lines.text: Up you go, dear. Oof. You had a snowball's chance in hell of reaching that.

lines.speaker: tiny
lines.text: A lipstick kiss. Still smoking. The plot thickens. Like slush.
